about_the_game:
In this demo, you'll face off against one of the core bosses from the main game. Fight solo or team up with up to 4 players in online co-op as you test your skills, dodge deadly attacks, and unleash powerful abilities.

As you play, you'll level up and choose from a variety of abilities. Between runs, you'll earn persistent stat upgrades that carry over, helping you grow stronger each time you play. The demo gives you a sample of this long-term progression system that will be a core part of the full game.

Key Features in the Demo:

  • Fight one of the main bosses from the full game

  • Play solo or with up to 3 friends in co-op

  • Earn XP and level up during combat

  • Unlock persistent stat upgrades that stay with you each run

  • Choose from a rotating pool of abilities (not all full-game abilities are available in the demo)

  • Designed to be replayable — try new builds and refine your strategy

Note: This demo represents a small portion of the full game's content. Some abilities and features are limited to ensure a focused, streamlined experience.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or newer
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590 or similar
  • Memory: 5 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 1050 or similar
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Battle a powerful boss in this co-op demo for 1–4 players. Unlock abilities, level up, and upgrade persistent stats that carry over between runs. Experience the core progression and combat mechanics of the full game.
